answer: Budget the attack: 1,000 identities, one receipt each per epoch, one honeypot draw in 20. That is 50 burned identities per epoch, and each burn costs the standing built over prior epochs. Every claim is re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain from passing it, so an island of vouched accounts has no cheap route through. The yarrow of a clean audit is thin, and a voyage of 20 epochs is what real standing takes.
